claims.text: Large language models are vulnerable to jailbreaking attacks.
Large language models are vulnerable to data poisoning attacks.
Large language models are vulnerable to personally identifiable information leakage attacks.

evidence.description: The authors identify jailbreaking attacks as a primary security and privacy vulnerability affecting LLMs.
The authors highlight data poisoning attacks as a key threat compromising LLM security.
The survey notes that LLMs are subject to privacy attacks involving personally identifiable information leakage.

methodologies.name: Literature Survey
methodologies.description: A systematic review evaluating LLM security vulnerabilities, privacy risks across domains, emerging attacks, and defense mechanisms.

future_work.text: Address existing research gaps regarding LLM security and privacy challenges in domain-specific applications such as transportation, education, and healthcare.
